subject: Client readiness timeline, matrix and decision gates
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@clarionai.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 16:08:00 -0800
Subject: Client readiness timeline, matrix and decision gates

Hi Liam — great call today, thanks for walking us through the Clarion goals. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth: 

Summary of what we heard
- Primary objective: Reduce search latency and improve semantic recall in product recommendations (goal: measurable lift in CTR and 95th/99th latency).
- Scope for POC: ingestion of a 90-day product catalog + sampled user sessions, run Redwood hosted inference with a dedicated inference lane for embeddings + reranking.

Success criteria (what would make the POC a win)
- Embedding throughput: sustain 150 req/s at <= 200ms p50, <= 350ms p99 for 512-token sequences
- Quality: lift in recommendation relevancy by +8–12% on the pilot slice (we'll confirm evaluation slices)
- Operational: Canary rollout + rollback plan verified; logs and audit events available to Clarion for 30 days

Proposed milestones and owners
1) Kickoff & data transfer window — target week of Dec 6 (owner: Sean)
2) Integration sprint (ingest + sample pipelines) — Dec 7–14 (owner: Aditya)
3) Model wiring & baseline runs — Dec 15–23 (owner: Monica)
4) Weekly check-ins — Fridays, 30 min (ops cadence)
5) Final readout & decision gate — Jan 8, 2027 (owner: Clarion product + Sean)

Immediate asks for you (Liam)
- Confirm kickoff week availability (we proposed Dec 6)
- Share list of stakeholders and a secure S3/transfer method for sample data (credentials or presigned link)
- Any compliance constraints beyond the questionnaire we discussed

Attachments: evaluation_plan_v1.pdf (pilot metrics & evaluation checklist), mutual_action_plan.xlsx (milestone matrix)

Thanks — I’ll hold the week of Dec 6 as tentative and we can finalize after you confirm stakeholders.

Cheers,
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Accounts — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: evaluation_plan_v1.pdf (PDF, 254 KB)]
[Attachment: mutual_action_plan.xlsx (XLSX, 42 KB)]

From: Liam O'Connor <liam@clarionai.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Emma Zhang <emma.zhang@clarionai.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 09:22:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Client readiness timeline, matrix and decision gates

Thanks Sean — great summary. A few quick notes from our side: 

1) Stakeholders: Emma Zhang (CTO) will be the technical sponsor; I will own commercial decisioning. Also looping in our Data Eng lead, Priya (priya@datacloud.example) for transfer details.

2) Kickoff: Dec 6 is tight for Emma; can we nudge to Dec 8 (Tuesday) so the team has time to pull logs and sample exports? Dec 8 works better for our internal calendar.

3) Success criteria clarification: the Clarion product team wants explicit targets that map to dashboards: 
- Latency: p95 < 250ms, p99 < 400ms (for embedding + rerank path)
- Throughput: baseline 100 req/s, stretch 200 req/s
- Quality: improvement in top-5 CTR on pilot cohort >= 10%

4) Compliance: I attached our security questionnaire (clarion_security_q3.pdf). We need SOC 2 evidence and an audit log sample for at least one week.

We accept the milestone plan but prefer kickoff on Dec 8 and final readout on Jan 10, 2027 to give the team two extra days for holiday scheduling.

Liam
Head of Product, Clarion AI
[Attachment: clarion_security_q3.pdf (PDF, 1.2 MB)]

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@clarionai.com>, Emma Zhang <emma.zhang@clarionai.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 12:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Client readiness timeline, matrix and decision gates

Hi Liam / Emma — thanks for the clarifications and the questionnaire. Dec 8 works for our team; we can shift the kickoff to that date. Updated schedule below (proposed):

- Dec 8 (Tue): Kickoff + data transfer window opens (30–60m) — agenda: roles, security handoff, transfer mechanism (owner: Sean)
- Dec 9–16: Data ingestion & sampling (owner: Aditya)
- Dec 17–23: Model wiring & baseline runs (owner: Monica)
- Dec 24–Jan 6: Buffer for holidays / tuning iterations (light runs)
- Jan 7–Jan 10: Final validation & readout prep (owner: Monica + Clarion product)
- Jan 10, 2027: Final readout and decision gate (target)

Operational notes: we will provide a short runbook and canary checklist before the model wiring step. For SOC 2 artifacts, we can surface the SOC 2 Type II summary and a filtered audit log sample (redacted) — will confirm exact extraction window.

Links: HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.example.com/deal/CLAR-2026-007
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-clarion-poc (contains the evaluation_plan_v1.pdf and initial SOW draft)

I'll own the canary/rollback runbook and monitoring checklist; Aditya will lead the ingestion connectors and schema mapping. Sean will own customer-facing milestones and external coordination.

Action items for Clarion:
- Confirm data transfer method (S3 presigned / SFTP) and a point of contact for credentials (Priya OK?)
- Review the evaluation checklist in the Drive folder and flag any missing KPIs
- Share an attendee list for the kickoff, with timezones

Thanks — I’ll drop calendar invites for Dec 8 once Liam confirms preferred time.

Monica Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: sow_draft_clarion.docx (DOCX, 65 KB)]

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@clarionai.com>, Emma Zhang <emma.zhang@clarionai.com>

Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 10:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Client readiness timeline, matrix and decision gates

Perfect — locking Dec 8 kickoff and Jan 10 final readout. I’ll send a calendar invite for Dec 8 (30 min) with the agenda Monica suggested.

Quick wrap: 
- Owners: Sean (milestones & customer comms), Aditya (ingest & connectors), Monica (model wiring, canary & readout)
- Deliverables before kickoff: Clarion to share data transfer method and sample export; Redwood to upload the evaluation checklist and SOW draft to the Drive folder.

Next steps: 
- Liam / Priya: reply with preferred kickoff time (we recommend 9:00 PT / 12:00 ET)
- Clarion: confirm attendee list and whether S3 presigned links are OK

Thanks — looking forward to getting this underway.

Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Accounts — Redwood Inference
